metadata.description: Curated open-data inspired linguistic seeds (Oxford 3000/5000 CEFR progressions, CMUdict minimal-pair IPA patterns, and Tatoeba/DailyDialog communicative contexts) used by scripts/generate-tracks.ts.
metadata.licenseNote: Educational seed metadata compiled for PT-BR -> EN CEFR A2-C1 curriculum generation.

cmudictPhoneticTraps.ptBrTrap: Merging long /iː/ and short lax /ɪ/ into a single Brazilian /i/
Adding an extra syllable (-ed pronounced as /ɛdʒɪ/) after voiceless stops/fricatives

cmudictPhoneticTraps.phonemes: Final /p, b, t, d, k, g, tʃ, dʒ/
cmudictPhoneticTraps.ptBrTrap: Adding a phantom /i/ vowel after word-final consonants (e.g., 'bug' -> 'buggy', 'app' -> 'appy')
Turning /æ/ into closed /ɛ/ or vocalizing final /l/ into /w/ (e.g., 'all' -> 'au')

C1.meaningPt: concessão / equilíbrio entre prós e contras

tatoebaAndDailyDialogSeeds.context: Ordering and clarifying daily tasks without dropping final consonants or mispronouncing 'th'
sampleSentences: I thought they worked through both bugs before lunch.
Please check the third draft and leave the notes on my desk.

tatoebaAndDailyDialogSeeds.context: Coffee shop, polite requests, and rescheduling an appointment naturally
sampleSentences: Could I get an iced oat latte and a toasted bagel, please?
I'm running about ten minutes late — could we push our call back slightly?

tatoebaAndDailyDialogSeeds.context: Daily standups, PR reviews, and explaining blockers clearly
sampleSentences: I finished the migration yesterday, and now I'm narrowing down a flaky test.
Before we merge this PR, let's make sure we're on the same page about edge cases.

tatoebaAndDailyDialogSeeds.context: Airport check-in, delayed flights, and resolving hotel reservation issues
sampleSentences: My connecting flight was delayed, so I'm worried I might miss my boarding window.
Could you check if there's a quieter room available away from the elevator?

tatoebaAndDailyDialogSeeds.context: Behavioral tech interviews, STAR stories, and explaining past ownership
sampleSentences: When we noticed a database bottleneck, I took ownership of profiling the slowest queries.
Walking stakeholders through the root cause helped us avoid rolling back the whole release.

tatoebaAndDailyDialogSeeds.context: Architecture design reviews, scalability limits, and articulating technical trade-offs
sampleSentences: Adding a distributed cache solves read latency, though the trade-off is eventual consistency.
If we bake graceful degradation into the gateway, one downstream outage won't become a single point of failure.
